title: The oil just kind of sat on top of the water
text: The oil just kind of sat on top of the water. This didn't work like other diffusers.  I couldn't smell the oil while it was running and it appeared the oil just sat on top of the water.  I didn't smell it in the "fog" as I do in my other diffuser.  It's great as a humidifier.  It puts out plenty of mist.
